scoring_justification: The only verifiable outputs are computed scalar values; recomputing from raw artifacts is infeasible because the raw artifacts are the final computed scalars themselves.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for low-frequency phase sensitivities (d31 and De Paula models) and resonance frequencies for the two samples.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported theoretical low-frequency sensitivities: 0.068 rad/(volt-turn) for Sample I (PZT-4), 0.055 for Sample II (PZT-5A). Resonance frequencies are 29000 Hz and 25600 Hz from the reference solve.sh (based on standard material constants). De Paula model sensitivities are 0.0189 and 0.0245 from the same solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and from the reference oracle which encodes the expected correct computation using standard material constants.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The phase sensitivity values are explicitly stated in the paper's Discussion section; the resonance frequencies are computed consistently with the paper's formula and material properties.

outputs.description: Computed low‑frequency phase sensitivity (paper's d31 model) and resonance frequency for Sample I (PZT-4) and Sample II (PZT-5A).
Computed low‑frequency phase sensitivity using De Paula's expression (d33) for the two samples.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the computed values to the paper's reported theoretical sensitivities with appropriate tolerances. Both files must have exactly two rows (one per sample) with the required columns.
